structured_output.plan: Implement a tiny CPU-safe dual-branch model (small conv stack for the 3x256x256 image + MLP for the 12-dim tabular features, fused via concatenation into a linear head predicting a single Pawpularity score). CandidateAdapter builds this model, an SGD-based optimizer, and synthetic float32 CPU batches (random tensors, no file I/O). training_step runs forward/backward/optimizer.step with MSE loss; validation_step runs forward-only MSE loss under torch.no_grad. All precision stays float32 (conservative policy, no AMP/fp16), no CUDA, no mocks — losses come from real tensor computation on randomly initialized data purely to validate the training loop's shape/dtype correctness under the RTX 5090 profile constraints.
